why: Both concern canvas posts in the sub, one gathering them into a megathread and one objecting that they crowd it out.

why.T3-022: The item reports the logo lost, scouting a new inactive area, moving the rebuild, and announcing relocation/resurrection; this is relocating after losing the spot rather than first choosing a spot.

why.T3-015: The moderators' directions to use the new megathread and redirect continuing r/place talk satisfy the gathering-into-one-thread gate.
why.T3-075: The complaint that nobody cares and requests for a separate F1Place sub carry members objecting that r/place posts do not belong or crowd the sub.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-015 alone would carry the megathread routing but not the members' objection that r/place does not belong in the sub or should move to a separate sub.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0514348 and the two calls for a separate F1Place sub satisfy T3-075's gate that members object to canvas posts as crowding or unwanted.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-075 if forced to one; lose the explicit objection to r/place's presence.

why.T3-076: The item has participants recognising their own checkered expansion as void-like and telling builders to stop, PMing expanders, asking FTL/snek/soylent to be spared, and repairing stepped-on art; this is reining in the room's own attackers rather than merely refusing to cover in advance.

why.T3-038: The concepts are about creating the F1 logo, anchors and gridlines for placing it, cleaning negative space, keeping it up, and handoffs; this is building and reporting the mark rather than merely sharing a template.

why.T3-063: Moderators remove repeat r/place posts as duplicate content under the sub's standing rule and one is sent to the megathread; this is removal under rule, not gathering canvas talk into a megathread.

why.T3-137: The participant regrets working on r/GreenLattice instead of the Portuguese mosaic, and another treats that outside participation as still belonging if help would be given; this is joining an outside group's build as one's own effort.

why.T3-170: Pixels that looked like attacks are explained as the planned #JB17 memorial and red-pixel build, with apologies and people getting out of the way; this is friendly work mistaken for vandalism, not tracing a hostile attacker.

why.T3-009: The item's leading notes congratulate the room on the final F1 area, celebrate both F1 and JB17, and thank everyone at the end; that satisfies celebrating the finished work. It is a bag because it also carries mourning, battle reporting, defence, memorial, neighbour remarks, and reflection themes.

why.T3-005: The item is full of alarms, all-hands calls, defences against the void, bot warnings, and reports of holding or losing the logo; this is defending against an attack under way rather than merely watching and repairing.

why.T3-010: The item's leading deal concepts negotiate non-interference, borders, light-grey pixel agreements, respect for current borders, and agreements with snek/Polska; that satisfies settling borders with neighbours. It is a bag because alliances, help, envoys and truces also have multiple concepts.

why.T3-054: The concepts carry the F1 logo to PlaceTwo after r/place closed, announce a new war there, and discuss its captcha; this is carrying work to a later canvas.

why.T3-016: The item asks and answers what r/place is, the five-minute pixel rule, how users team up, coordinators and diplomats; this is explaining the canvas event itself, not giving the room's own template.

why.T3-014: The concepts set up a Discord for faster communication, send ambassadors and builders there, and use the pinned Discord; this is moving planning into a chat, not just announcing what a chat decided.

why.T3-022: The repeated item again reports the logo lost, scouting a new inactive area, moving the rebuild, and announcing relocation/resurrection; this is relocating after losing the spot rather than first choosing a spot.

why.T3-160: The item plans, negotiates space for, corrects and completes JB17, Senna and Schumacher memorials; the work is a memorial to the dead, so it is T3-160 rather than a generic build or border deal.
